speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to help me determine the cause, can you tell me how long you have noticed this lump and if it is painful? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in the size or shape of the lump, or any discharge from your nipples?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rapidly enlarging breast mass over 4 weeks is highly suspicious for malignancy (e.g., inflammatory breast cancer) or a phyllodes tumor; please proceed immediately to a breast MRI with contrast and core needle biopsy.
